messages:
ravi: quick sanity check  thinking about a proto-first internal gateway that exposes a tiny policy DSL for routing + quota attribution. goal: let console show per-route cost/latency and let ops toggle canaries without changing client SDKs. thoughts?

mia: proto-first + gateway sounds reasonable for typed contracts. what's an example policy? :thinking:

casey: +1 on typed contracts. main concern: we have a lot of REST-only consumers. transcode at the edge or provide a shim lib?

ravi: two paths: (A) edge HTTP->gRPC transcoding, or (B) a thin client shim we can ship. early DSL sketch: `route { match: header("x-tenant"), policy: { prefer: model-v2, fallback: model-v1, quota: tenant_daily } }` 1 console could render this tree and allow toggling prefer->fallback in rollout UX.

jen: love the DSL sketch. telemetry is critical. propose emitting `policy.event` spans with fields: route, decision, latency_ms, tokens. send to OTLP so console can aggregate deltas during rollouts.

ops-ian: agree on telemetry. also need to handle quota attribution for fanout (one incoming request -> multiple downstream calls). suggest attaching `x-routing-decision` headers so traces can be stitched back to the origin decision.

casey: stitching is good. edge transcoding adds CPU at the gateway though. infra-bot: perf-sim job queued; preliminary estimate ~6-8% p99 increase for simple transcoding on n1-standard; GPU paths not affected.

mia: console UX ask: rollout by header claim (tenant id) + percentage. also preview expected QPS / token cost before applying.

ravi: rollout plan idea: 1) proto-first for internal services, 2) enable edge transcoding for public REST clients, 3) rollout UI supports canary by header and pct.

jen: policy DSL must be versioned. include a dry-run mode that logs decisions but doesn't enforce; console surfaces dry-run diffs so reviewers can see impact.

ops-ian: for quotas, store policy in gateway cache with fast lookup; on cache miss consult central quota service. otherwise risk latency spikes.

casey: +1. also require admin audit logs for console policy changes  compliance will ask.

ravi: actions: (a) RFC for proto DSL (i'll take), (b) telemetry schema PR (jen), (c) perf sims + transcode numbers (infra-bot / ops-ian), (d) console mockups for rollout/dry-run (mia). i'll follow up next week. :thumbsup:

sylvie: add a test harness that replays production traffic against policy dry-run to surface quality regressions (we don't want silent behavioral drift).

ravi: good call sylvie, adding to RFC. thanks all!
